description: This file defines the ApiPermission class which is an ORM entity representing API permission entries in the database. It contains properties for id, apiName, module, and dataGroup, along with their respective getters and setters, mapped using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: ApiPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing API permission records, with ORM mappings for database integration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the API permission.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the API permission.

methods.name: getApiName
methods.description: Returns the name of the API.

methods.name: setApiName
methods.description: Sets the name of the API.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates the ApiPermission with a Module entity.

methods.name: setDataGroup
methods.description: Associates the ApiPermission with a DataGroup entity.
